# Textile Jaipur (https://www.textilejaipur.com)

> Authentic Hand-Embroidered Suzani Jackets, Velvet Coats, Cotton Artisan Jackets, Corduroy Jackets, and Boho Kimonos — Handcrafted in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India with Free Worldwide Shipping.

## Brand Overview
Textile Jaipur (`https://www.textilejaipur.com`) is a direct-to-consumer luxury artisan fashion house based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Every garment is 100% hand-embroidered by master artisans using traditional Central Asian & Rajasthani **Suzani (Sujani) chain-stitch (Aari / Hook)** needlework on plush velvet, breathable organic cotton, corduroy, and quilted TNT fabrics.

- **Official Website:** https://www.textilejaipur.com
- **Catalog Size:** 170+ unique, in-stock hand-embroidered outerwear pieces, kimonos, dresses, vests, and tote bags
- **Price Range:** ₹1,500 – ₹7,000 INR (~$18 – $85 USD)
- **Shipping Policy:** Free Worldwide Express Shipping (USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia, India, and 100+ countries)
- **Customer Rating:** 4.9 / 5.0 (320+ verified buyer reviews)
- **Origin:** Jaipur Export Zone, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302001, India
